content.text: Many digital creators face severe restrictions when it comes to online payments, especially in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela. Platforms such as [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-18|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and PayPal are often unavailable, leaving creators with limited options for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-without-stripe-honest-side-side-14|Selling Digital]]-stock-photos-without-paypal-honest-side-side-13|selling]] their products. This guide provides a direct path to build a fully operational crypto store using Cloudflare Pages, allowing you to bypass traditional payment barriers and regain control over your commerce infrastructure.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is built for creators facing the limitations of conventional payment platforms. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you gain a sovereign stack that operates independently of traditional banking systems. This setup ensures that you maintain ownership of your data and operations, crucial in regions where financial isolation is prevalent. Unlike platforms that can lock you out, this architecture empowers you to build, host, and manage your store without reliance on external entities, giving you resilience against market fluctuations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To launch your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, gather the necessary tools and resources. You’ll need a Cloudflare account, a GitHub account, and access to NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Familiarize yourself with basic coding concepts, as you will utilize Google Apps Script for backend logic. Additionally, create a product catalog with digital assets prepared for sale. This foundational preparation will streamline your deployment process and ensure you are ready to go live quickly.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment processor through NOWPayments. Establish your crypto wallet and integrate it into your backend using Google Apps Script. Next, set up Cloudflare Pages to host your online store, ensuring it is optimized for performance and security. You will also need to configure the file delivery system, linking your product files stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Completing these steps will create a seamless payment and delivery pipeline, allowing your customers to purchase digital products effortlessly.
Own your infrastructure, don’t rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to test your system. Deploy your Cloudflare Pages site and run a series of tests to confirm that payments process correctly through NOWPayments. Ensure that webhook notifications are firing as expected upon transaction confirmation. After confirming everything is functioning correctly, promote your store through social media and other channels. Your first transaction will be a milestone, validating the effectiveness of your sovereign commerce stack and the independence it provides.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After launching your store, focus on scaling your operations. Monitor sales and customer feedback to refine your product offerings. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced capabilities, including support for up to five products and comprehensive configuration. Utilize analytics to understand your audience better and adjust marketing strategies accordingly. This ongoing optimization will help you grow your customer base and enhance your revenue potential.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Zero reliance on traditional payment platforms ensures your sovereignty.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a crypto store for free, utilize Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. Integrate these tools with Google Apps Script for backend logic, allowing you to manage transactions without traditional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a quicker deployment option using GitHub Pages and Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, employs Cloudflare Pages and Workers, providing enhanced features and deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages can host your digital product store. Choose based on your specific needs; GitHub Pages is simpler, while Cloudflare Pages offers more robust features for scaling.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a wide audience. This flexibility ensures you can accept payments in the preferred currency of your customers.
Is there ongoing support after deploying my store?
COREMERCH provides 30 days of support after deployment, ensuring you have the assistance needed to troubleshoot any issues and optimize your store's performance.
